cause: Training/serving skew on f2 caused by a missing log transform in the serving path. Joining both feature groups on entity_id over the 200 shared entities (computed platform-side via Trino), f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (mean abs diff 0, corr 1.0), while f2 diverges (corr 0.93). The relationship is exact: f2_training = ln(1 + f2_serving) (i.e. log1p), with max residual ~5e-7. So the training pipeline applies a log1p transform to f2, but the online service serves the raw, un-transformed value (equivalently serving = expm1(training)). The fix is to apply the same log1p transform on the serving path (or register it as an on-demand/model-dependent transformation in the feature view so both paths share it).
